html:
Question 6
?

Find the Laplace transform Y(s)=L{y(t)} if y″+9y=5u4(t)e3(t−4),y(0)=0,y′(0)=0, where u4(t)=u(t−4) is the unit step function.

a
Y(s)=5e−4s(s−3)(s2+9)
b
Y(s)=e−4s(s−3)(s2+9)
c
Y(s)=5e−4ss2+9
d
Y(s)=5e−4ss2(s−3)
e
Y(s)=5e−4s(s+3)(s2+9)
Submit
